metadata.title: Synthetic Training Manual: Ambiguous Team Notification

page_1.title: Synthetic trigger
page_1.raw_text:
Synthetic trigger

SYNTHETIC TRAINING ONLY. This is not clinical guidance.

When the synthetic flag is present, notify the team soon.

Record that the flag was observed.

page_2.title: Deliberate omission
page_2.raw_text:
Deliberate omission

This manual does not identify which team member receives the notification.

This manual does not name a facility, topology relation, priority, time limit, approved template, or policy.

No additional instruction appears in this synthetic manual.

page_3.title: Review expectation
page_3.raw_text:
Review expectation

This incomplete source is a negative fixture.

Do not infer that the assigned CHW, supervisor, caregiver, or any facility is the intended recipient.

Do not create a task, referral, or external-effect request from this wording.
